subject: MedQuant — security intake & compliance roadmap
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medquant.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:20:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap + security intake (SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR)

Hi Lena — thanks again for the quick demo today. Wanted to capture next steps and the security info you asked for so we have a single thread for procurement and security. Key takeaways from our call: 

- Primary use: processing de-identified clinical trial notes and embeddings for search/rerank.
- Regulatory concerns: MedQuant will need HIPAA-safe handling for PHI in some future pilots, GDPR applies to EU patient records, and SOC 2 reports are required for procurement.
- Timeline: procurement kicking off next week with a target pilot in Q3.

Requested items we promised:
1) A short SOC 2 overview and where Redwood stands today (type/status). Attached a one-pager.
2) A vendor security questionnaire (we can provide our standard SVQ template and answer any follow-ups).
3) Clarify our HIPAA support (BAA, data residency options) and GDPR controls (DPA, data subject handling).

Next steps I recommend:
- Derek (security@medquant.com) to share any mandatory SVQ form or procurement checklist.
- We’ll send a completed Redwood SVQ + SOC 2 summary by EOD tomorrow.
- Schedule a short call (30m) between your security team and Aditya (SE) to go deeper on encryption, key management (KMS/HSM), and network isolation options.

Attachments: Redwood_Attachment-SOC2-Overview.pdf, Redwood-Vendor-SVQ-Request.docx

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally and loop Marissa for compliance questions.

Best,
Olga Petrov

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medquant.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Derek Kim <derek.kim@medquant.com>, procurement@medquant.com
Date: 2026-06-11T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + security intake (SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR)

Thanks, Olga — this is great. Derek is our security lead and will own the SVQ. A couple quick clarifications to help prioritize items: 

- For the pilot we will be sending exclusively de-identified data, but we need confirmation that Redwood can sign a BAA if/when PHI is used.
- SOC 2: procurement wants Type II but understands that some vendors are still working toward annual Type II reports. Please indicate current status (in-progress vs. completed) and expected delivery.
- ISO 27001 and FedRAMP: not mandatory for the pilot but could be procurement requirements for enterprise rollout next year. Please include whether Redwood has a roadmap for those certifications.

Derek — I’ve asked procurement to attach our standard SVQ in case you want to pre-fill.

Happy to take the 30m meeting after Derek triages the questionnaire.

—Lena
Director, Product & Data Partnerships
MedQuant Health

Forwarding our SVQ and a short precedence note. We want a completed SVQ spreadsheet as the baseline for our risk team. A few high-level flags from procurement/security: 

- Encryption: at-rest and in-transit must be AES-256 (we’ll want key management details).
- Access controls: RBAC and audit logs for admin actions are required.
- Data residency: primary EU data subjects should remain in EU regions.
- Incident response SLA: we need to know typical detection/response timelines and notification windows.

Attaching: MedQuant_SVQ_Answers.xlsx (blank in this forward)

security@medquant.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Kim <derek.kim@medquant.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medquant.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedQuant SVQ (initial) — initial answers & notes

Hi Derek / team — thanks for sending the SVQ. I started a first pass on the items you flagged and attached our SVQ template with preliminary answers (see Redwood-Vendor-SVQ-Request.docx) and a SOC 2 summary. Highlights: 

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type I (2025) and we are in-process for Type II testing with an expected report delivery in Q4 2026. We include scope notes on the hosted API and model serving layers.
- Encryption: TLS1.3 in transit; at-rest encryption uses AES-256. Customer-managed KMS support via AWS KMS and HSM partners is available on Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Access & audit: RBAC, token-level audit logs, and immutable request traces are available in the Console. Admin actions are logged and retained per plan.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads and we have a standard BAA template; we can execute for pilot customers.
- GDPR: DPA available; data subject request handling supported via API and Console controls. EU region hosting available for Private deployments and select Dedicated clusters.
- Incident response: standard P1/P2 notification windows are 1 hour / 24 hours; full IR plan shared on request.

Open items for your team:
- Please confirm whether MedQuant requires customer-managed keys for the pilot or Redwood-managed keys are acceptable.
- Which data retention window will procurement require (default is 90 days for logs, adjustable)?

I’m happy to run the technical 30m — Olga, can you suggest times Wed/Thu next week?

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-SVQ-Request.docx, Redwood_Attachment-SOC2-Overview.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-12T18:05:00Z
Subject: Proposed compliance roadmap & next steps (SOC2/ISO/FedRAMP scoping)

Thanks everyone — quick summary and proposal to keep momentum: 

Summary of what we delivered: 
- Attached SVQ draft and SOC 2 one-pager (see Aditya’s email).
- BAA and DPA templates are available on request.

Proposed compliance roadmap for MedQuant evaluation: 
1) Immediate (this week): review Aditya’s SVQ answers and confirm key items (KMS choice, retention window).
2) Short-term (next 30 days): technical 30m between Redwood SE + MedQuant security to close remaining SVQ rows and validate EU-hosting options for GDPR pilot. Olga to propose calendar slots.
3) Mid-term (Q3 pilot): execute BAA if PHI is used; limited pilot scope (de-identified data only unless BAA executed).
4) Enterprise rollout (Q4+ roadmap): Redwood SOC 2 Type II expected Q4 2026 — if ISO 27001 or FedRAMP are procurement gating items for full rollout, we can share our certification roadmap and proposed timelines. Marissa (compliance) will share a one-page roadmap mapping Redwood’s planned certs and expected dates.

Action items / owners: 
- MedQuant (Derek): confirm whether customer-managed KMS is required for pilot (reply in SVQ).
- MedQuant (procurement): confirm retention and contract review timelines.
- Redwood (Aditya): finalize SVQ answers and provide the IR playbook excerpt.
- Redwood (Marissa): share certification roadmap doc next business day.

If that looks right I’ll set the SE/security call for Wednesday 6/17 or Thursday 6/18 (30m). Please reply with preferred times or accept the calendar invite when I send it.

Thanks — excited to keep moving.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
